pretreatment: dipped in a diluted HF solution (1% HF) for 1 min and rinsed with de-ionized water
evidence: The TiN and HfO2 films were deposited on 200 mm p-type monocrystalline Si (100) wafers with a resistivity of 10–30 Ω·cm. Unless otherwise mentioned, the wafers were not additionally cleaned and therefore an ~2 nm native oxide layer was present. For electrical characterization some HfO2 films were grown on boron doped p-type monocrystalline Si substrates (1–10 Ω·cm), which were dipped in a diluted HF solution (1% HF) for 1 min and rinsed with de-ionized water prior to deposition.
